- **Two items are pending.** The S3 read requests and the KMS decrypt-on-read requests can't be priced because the read frequency hasn't been supplied. They are not counted in the totals, and they are not zero. The status is therefore partial (PARTIAL_PENDING_INPUTS).

This is an internal planning estimate, not an invoice or committed run rate.
